items.ja: 週替わりランチカレー
items.note: Contents change weekly — ask that week's ingredients; curry base is not documented wheat-free
Shop says the curry uses no oil, but never states it is wheat-free — Japanese curry is normally thickened with wheat flour. Ask, and ask about meat stock too

items.en: Tofu curry (boiled tofu and wakame on curry)
items.note: Topping is just boiled tofu and wakame, so this is the closest thing to a plant-based option — but the curry base itself is unconfirmed for wheat and for meat stock
Egg topping; curry base not documented wheat-free

items.ja: 豚肉のしょうが焼きカレー
items.note: Pork is marinated in an apple-onion-ginger tare; shogayaki tare is soy-sauce based, so wheat is present
Chicken is described as 香ばしい (browned) — confirm no flour dredge; curry base not documented wheat-free
Seafood is boiled, not battered, but the curry base is not documented wheat-free

items.en: Hamburg steak curry (yam and tofu in the patty)
items.note: Japanese hamburg patties are bound with panko unless stated otherwise — treat as wheat
Curry base not documented wheat-free
Apple is fried in dairy butter; curry base not documented wheat-free

items.ja: クリーミーバナナカレー
items.note: Listed as a special; 'creamy' suggests dairy — confirm, and the curry base is not documented wheat-free
Listed as a special, no price posted; steak sauce and curry base both unconfirmed for wheat
Vegetables are fine; the dressing is the risk — Japanese house dressings usually contain soy sauce (wheat) and often egg

items.ja: トッピング：とろけるチーズ
items.note: Dairy cheese. Processed melting cheese is usually wheat-free but some Japanese blends use starch or modified fillers — ask before adding it to a curry you are trusting
Plain egg
Black coffee; no price posted on the shop's menu page

items.en: Single-origin coffee (Mocha, Kilimanjaro, Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, Mandheling, premium blend)
items.note: Black coffee; no price posted

items.en: Black tea (Brooke Bond, Darjeeling, Orange Pekoe, Earl Grey)
items.note: Plain tea — order without milk
Made with dairy milk
Dairy; instant cocoa mixes sometimes carry malt or wheat starch — ask if you are strict
Dairy yoghurt drink
Fruit juice

items.ja: 日替わりおすすめケーキ
items.note: Ordinary wheat-flour cake, changes daily; no gluten-free or vegan version is documented

items.ja: 赤米とほうれん草の豆乳リゾット
items.romaji: Akamai to Hourensou no Tounyuu Rizotto
items.note: This is the dish Japanese media called グルテンフリー in 2019 — but it is seasoned on a MISO base and no source names the miso type (barley/wheat miso is common). Worse, a FindMeGlutenFree reviewer in Aug 2026 reported speaking to the chef directly and being told he will no longer provide gluten-free food. Do not assume; confirm on the day. Soy milk, not dairy — staff once confirmed dairy-free — but the side salad arrives dressed and the dressing is not confirmed vegan

items.ja: 鶏もも肉と茸のトマトカレー
items.romaji: Torimomoniku to Kinoko no Tomato Karee
items.en: Chicken thigh and mushroom tomato curry
items.note: Chicken. Some FindMeGlutenFree visitors say staff confirmed the curry is gluten-free, but the same listing records no dedicated fryer and the Aug 2026 report that GF is no longer offered. Rice is cooked with ancient grains mixed in — ask which grains
Wheat noodles, and the tare is soy-sauce based. Hiroshima dry tantanmen normally carries minced pork — ask
Rice instead of noodles, but the same soy-sauce and sesame tare — ask about wheat in the sauce and about minced pork
Wheat noodles and a soy-based dipping sauce. HappyCow reviewers say you can ask for the Hiroshima noodles without bacon and egg

items.ja: 磯入れ小盛り赤米プラス
items.en: Small extra portion of red rice with seaweed
items.note: Add-on side of red rice; confirm the ancient-grain blend contains no barley and that the seaweed seasoning has no soy sauce

items.ja: ブルーチーズと生ハムのホットサンド
items.romaji: Buruu Chiizu to Namahamu no Hotto Sando
items.en: Blue cheese and prosciutto hot sandwich
items.note: Wheat bread, dairy cheese and cured pork

HappyCow reviewers name fries as the fallback when nothing else is available — but FindMeGlutenFree records NO dedicated fryer here, so the oil is shared with breaded items. Ask about the fryer and the seasoning
Battered and breaded chicken in a shared fryer

items.ja: 自家製濃厚ベークドチーズケーキ
items.note: Described as cream cheese, parmesan and sour cream — dairy, so not vegan. Japanese baked cheesecake usually contains some wheat flour and often a biscuit base; ask. This is the shop's only regular sweet

items.ja: ドリンクケーキセット
items.note: Cake plus a drink; the cake is the dairy cheesecake or a pound cake

items.ja: パウンドケーキ（ほうじ茶とホワイトチョコ／ラムレーズン／チョコレート）
items.en: Pound cake (hojicha and white chocolate / rum raisin / chocolate)
items.note: Wheat-flour pound cake with butter and egg; no gluten-free or vegan version documented
Wheat-flour scone with dairy
Dairy ice cream; ask whether a wafer or biscuit is served with it

items.ja: オーガニックブレンドコーヒー
items.note: The cafe's signature drink; black coffee. Ask for soy milk if you want it white — reviewers note they forgot to and got dairy
Plain tea
Made with dairy milk as served; soy milk is available on request — say so when ordering
Beer is brewed from barley malt — not gluten-free
Wine is grape-based, but some wines are fined with egg or isinglass — ask if that matters to you
Plain salted nuts
Japanese mixed-nut packs sometimes include soy-sauce-coated or wheat-cracker pieces — check the bowl

items.en: Set meal of the day (ticket machine)
items.note: One reported day's set was mapo tofu, DEEP-FRIED GYOZA, salad, rice, miso soup, pickles and annin tofu — the gyoza wrapper is wheat and the miso soup is a further wheat/barley risk. Contents rotate daily, so ask what today's set is. The shop is meat- and fish-free with plant-based dashi, but a few items contain egg
Mapo sauce uses soy sauce and doubanjiang, both usually wheat-containing; the set's side dishes and soup are unconfirmed. No tamari is documented here

Rice-based rather than noodle-based, so the main wheat risk is the sauce: soy sauce and doubanjiang. The mince is soy meat, not wheat gluten, and the shop says its dashi is plant-based — but ask, since a few dishes carry egg
Same soy-sauce and doubanjiang base as the mapo bowl; aubergine is often pre-fried, so ask about the fryer too
Fried rice is normally finished with soy sauce. One blogger believed he saw egg in it — the shop labels egg-containing items on its own menu, so check that label
Soy-sauce seasoned; check the menu's egg marking
Soy sauce plus doubanjiang; check the menu's egg marking
Wheat noodles and a wheat-based yakisoba sauce. Notably meat-free — a reviewer records thick fried tofu (厚揚げ) used in place of meat

Wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth — doubly wheat. On the vegan side this is one of the better bets: a reviewer reports the noodles are egg-free and the shop says its dashi is plant-based; confirm both
Wheat noodles. Reported as egg-free noodles with plant-based stock — confirm
Wheat noodles plus doubanjiang and soy sauce
Named for the shojin/sosai tradition, so likely the most plant-based bowl on the board — but the noodles are still wheat
Wheat noodles with a soy-based sauce

items.ja: 揚げ餃子・焼き餃子・水餃子
items.romaji: Age Gyoza / Yaki Gyoza / Sui Gyoza
items.note: Gyoza wrappers are wheat flour in every form. Filling is vegetable and soy meat with no garlic or chives — a reviewer found them mild for exactly that reason
Wheat dumpling skin
Wheat wrapper; shumai wrappers sometimes contain egg — check the menu's egg marking

Karaage batter is wheat-based unless proven otherwise, and this is a shared fryer. The mock meat itself is SOY, not wheat gluten — every source that names it says 大豆ミート. Reviewers rate this the standout dish
Tofu-vegetable balls are usually bound with flour or starch and fried — ask which, and ask about the fryer
Billed on the shop's board as the vegan vegetable stir-fry and reported as a daily-set main. Wheat risk is the soy sauce in the wok seasoning
Made with soy meat, not pork. The pieces are coated and fried (flour or potato starch — ask which) and the sauce is soy-sauce based
Soy meat with peppers; the wheat risk is the soy sauce and oyster-style sauce in the wok
Oyakodon is bound with beaten EGG — this is one of the few egg dishes here, so not vegan. The broth is soy-sauce based
Included in the daily set, served with goji berries. Almond jelly is normally set with agar and is wheat-free, but confirm — and confirm the milk used is plant-based
A shared course drawing on the whole menu, so wheat noodles and dumplings will be on the table and serving utensils are shared

items.ja: チリ・コン・カルネ（ビーンズ）
items.en: Chili con carne — bean version (comes with 1 tortilla)
items.note: The bean version is the standout order here. The shop states in writing that its CORN tortillas contain no wheat flour and are suitable for people with a gluten allergy, and a visitor reports the printed menu carries explicit gluten-free and vegan icons against the vegetarian chili. Beans, tomato and spices are naturally wheat-free. Shared kitchen and one cook — still say celiac and show the card

items.ja: チリ・コン・カルネ（ビーフ＆ビーンズ）
items.en: Chili con carne — beef and beans (comes with 1 tortilla)
items.note: The meat version of the same dish. Ask whether it carries the same gluten-free mark as the bean version
Shop statement: corn tortillas use no wheat flour. Pick the BEANS filling for vegan. Ask about the taco seasoning, and note that hard shells are deep-fried tortillas so the fryer is a question
Rice-based, so no tortilla question. Choose beans for vegan. On weekday lunch (12:00-13:00) it arrives with miso soup — miso can be barley-based, so decline it or ask
The shop keeps BOTH regular and VEGAN cheese and asks vegans to say so when ordering — so this can be made dairy-free on request. Confirm the tortilla used is the corn one

items.ja: パレスチナの野菜スープ
items.note: A vegetable soup, so plausibly plant-based, but no ingredient list is published — ask about the stock and any flour thickening
Sold on its own. The shop states plainly that the corn tortilla is made without wheat flour and can be eaten by people with a gluten allergy
Plain rice side. The shop uses unsprayed brown rice from Kadofuji Farm in Fukutomi, Hiroshima

items.en: Daily lunch — main, 2 sides, miso soup, brown rice
items.note: You are asked to choose MEAT or VEGETABLES, so a plant-based version exists. The additive-free miso soup is the gluten risk — miso is often barley- or wheat-based. Listed on the shop site; a June 2025 visitor found the menu cut back, so confirm it is still running

From the shop site's dedicated VEGETARIAN & VEGAN section. Lentil curries are often naturally wheat-free but no roux statement is published — ask. May not currently be available (see the 2025 menu reduction)
Listed under the shop site's VEGETARIAN & VEGAN heading. Ask what bread or grain comes with it. May not currently be available

items.ja: ライ麦パンのオープンサンド
items.note: Vegan, but RYE is a gluten grain and Japanese rye loaves are almost always blended with wheat — not an option for coeliacs even though it sits in the vegan section
Egg- and dairy-free by design, but no flour statement is published — assume wheat unless the staff say otherwise
On both the shop site and the current 2025 board. Plant-based; ask whether anything grain-based goes in
Corn chips are usually wheat-free and the shop can supply vegan cheese on request — but confirm the chips and the fryer. Shop-site item; may not currently be available
Avocado with corn chips; ask about the fryer and any dairy in the dip
A rice dish with sausage; ask about the sausage and the spice base. A reviewer found the chilli heat well judged and the portion modest
Rolled tortillas baked in sauce. Confirm the corn tortilla is used and ask what thickens the sauce; vegan cheese is available on request

items.ja: ケーキセット（コーヒーor紅茶付き）
items.en: Cake set with coffee or tea — pumpkin pie, apple crumble pie, banana cake, pecan pie, brownie, or vegan cake
items.note: Choose from six cakes. All are wheat-flour bakes; the vegan cake is the only dairy- and egg-free choice, and it is still wheat

items.ja: オーガニックコーヒー／オーガニック紅茶
items.note: Black. The 2025 board prices these at ¥500
Spiced milk tea — ask for it made with a plant milk if you need vegan
Dairy yoghurt drink

items.ja: ジンジャエール／コーラ／オレンジジュース
items.note: Soft drinks

items.ja: ビール（ハートランド／オリオン／コロナ／ギネス）
items.note: All barley-malt beers, so not gluten-free. The Sapporo non-alcoholic beer at ¥500 is malt-based too

items.en: Organic wine — quarter bottle ¥900, full bottle ¥3,500
items.note: French organic Cabernet Merlot or Chardonnay. Wine is grape-based; some wines are fined with egg or isinglass

items.ja: マリナーラ（チーズなし）
items.en: Marinara — tomato, garlic, oregano, NO CHEESE
items.note: The cheapest and most reliably vegan thing here. It carries a crossed-out cheese icon on both the main Japanese menu and the shop's dedicated bilingual VEGETARIAN PIZZA page (headed 'No fish / No meat'). Wheat dough though — the shop's own menu states the dough is flour, salt, yeast and water, and there is no gluten-free base

items.ja: マリナーラ シャンピニオン（チーズなし）
items.en: Marinara champignon — garlic, oregano, button mushrooms, NO CHEESE
items.note: Number two of the four pizzas the shop itself flags as no-cheese. Wheat dough

items.ja: マリナーラ スペシャル（チーズなし）
items.en: Marinara special — garlic, oregano, olives, basil, capers, NO CHEESE
items.note: The most loaded of the vegan pizzas. Wheat dough

items.ja: クアトロ フンギ（チーズなし）
items.en: Quattro funghi — maitake, eringi, enoki, bunashimeji in garlic olive oil, NO CHEESE
items.note: Four-mushroom white pizza with no cheese, marked vegan-safe on the shop's own vegetarian page. Wheat dough

items.ja: シチリアーナ（チーズなし）
items.en: Siciliana — anchovy, olive, garlic, capers, oregano, NO CHEESE
items.note: Cheese-free but NOT vegan — it is built on anchovies. Wheat dough

items.ja: ナポレターナ（チーズなし）
items.en: Napoletana — basil, garlic, anchovy, oregano, olives, NO CHEESE
items.note: Cheese-free but contains anchovy. Wheat dough
Wheat dough, dairy mozzarella. Note the shop states you may order ANY pizza without cheese — so this becomes vegan if you ask for it senza formaggio
Wheat dough, cured pork, dairy

items.ja: ハモンセラーノルッコラ
items.en: Jamon serrano and rocket — mozzarella, rocket, Spanish cured ham
items.note: Wheat dough, cured pork, dairy

items.en: Quattro formaggi rossa — gorgonzola, pecorino, ricotta, mozzarella
items.note: Wheat dough and four dairy cheeses
Wheat dough, egg, pork and dairy
White pizza; wheat dough and dairy. Can be ordered without cheese on request, which would leave basil on oiled dough

items.ja: マルゲリータビアンカ
items.en: Margherita bianca — basil, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella
items.note: Wheat dough and dairy
A folded wheat-dough pizza with pork and two dairy cheeses

items.ja: クアトロフォルマッジ
items.en: Quattro formaggi bianca — gorgonzola, ricotta, pecorino, mozzarella
items.note: Wheat dough and four dairy cheeses

items.ja: シェフのおすすめ前菜盛り合せ
items.note: The plate changes, and reviewers have found quiche and cured meats on it. Ask item by item — this is the only part of the menu that could avoid wheat
Plain olives — the safest small plate on the menu
Vegetables in vinegar; ask whether the pickling liquid contains any wheat-derived seasoning

items.en: Pane — pizza dough baked plain with house oil
items.note: Literally the pizza dough baked on its own — dairy-free and egg-free, but pure wheat
Potatoes are fine, but this fryer also cooks floured chicken wings — ask whether the oil is shared
Wings are floured before frying, which is also what contaminates the fryer for the chips

items.ja: グリーンサラダ 生ハムのせ
items.note: Cured pork on top; ask for it without the ham and check the dressing if you want it plant-based

items.ja: 米粉ココアパウンドケーキ
items.en: Rice-flour cocoa pound cake (listed as the vegetarian dessert)
items.note: A visitor asked the owner directly about egg, butter and milk and was told none are used — she brought out the full ingredient list in English, so this is genuinely vegan. But do NOT read rice flour as gluten-free: no gluten-free claim is made, Hiroshima rice-flour bakes commonly have wheat gluten added, and this is baked in a pizzeria full of wheat flour
A 2019 visitor reported two of the gelato flavours contained neither egg nor dairy — but the milk flavour obviously does. Ask which flavour is which today
Cream-set dessert — dairy
Wheat-flour chocolate cake with egg and butter
Plain fruit — the only dessert that is both vegan and free of wheat

items.ja: ランチセット（前菜またはサラダ＋ピッツァ＋ドリンク）
items.en: Lunch set — antipasto or salad + pizza + drink
items.note: Lunch is pizza-only at this shop, so the set is built on wheat dough — but you can take a marinara inside it. Reservations are effectively required; the room fills at opening. Recent listings put the lunch average around ¥1,188

items.ja: お豆腐マフィン 玄米水飴キャラメルナッツ
items.romaji: Otoufu Mafin Genmai Mizuame Kyarameru Nattsu
items.en: Tofu muffin — brown-rice-syrup caramel and nuts
items.note: The shop's own Instagram bio states it bakes 主に国産小麦 — mainly domestic WHEAT flour — so every muffin here contains gluten. No egg, no dairy, no white sugar; silken tofu gives the crumb its texture. ¥100 off when taken with a drink

items.ja: 有機ココアのお豆腐マフィン
items.note: Described by the shop as 国産小麦100% with beet sugar — wheat, so not gluten-free. Egg-free and dairy-free

items.ja: お豆腐マフィン ほうじ茶＆粒あん
items.en: Tofu muffin — hojicha and chunky red bean
items.note: Wheat-flour muffin, egg-free and dairy-free. Three or four muffin flavours rotate daily, so the exact line-up changes day to day

items.ja: キャロブチップスコーン
items.note: Wheat-flour scone. The chips are carob (イナゴ豆), not cocoa or dairy chocolate — that is what keeps it vegan
Twice-baked offcuts of the wheat muffins. Price has drifted from ¥110 in 2022 to ¥150 in 2025
The shop publishes the full ingredient list: 国産小麦粉・水・甜菜糖・塩・少量のドライイースト, hand-kneaded and slowly fermented. Wheat flour, so not gluten-free — but it is vegan. Must be ordered ahead

Made with organically grown Hatsukaichi strawberries and no added sugar. The fruit is naturally gluten-free, but this is a small bakery handling wheat flour daily — ask about airborne flour and shared equipment if you are coeliac

items.ja: ブルーベリー＆豆乳スムージー
items.note: Soy milk, not dairy. Same shared-premises wheat-flour caveat as the other drinks
Changes with the season and sells out — recent versions used pesticide-free Hiroshima amanatsu citrus. Same shared-premises wheat caveat

items.ja: おやつ＋ドリンクセット割
items.note: Take any baked item with a drink for ¥100 off. Everything in the case is vegan — but everything in the case is also wheat, so the set is no help to a coeliac
